rows.grounds: compound numeral indicating one hundred increased by eight
refers to the three qualified reciters mentioned previously
fused form pṛthak + anuttamam emphasizing each separately as the best manner

items.question: How many recitations must each qualified Vedic reciter perform separately?
premises: Three reciters knowing the four Vedas are to be chosen.
The prescribed number is one hundred and eight.
Each reciter must perform the recitations separately.
items.inference: Each of the three qualified reciters must individually perform one hundred and eight recitations.
uncertainties: The exact object of recitation is supplied from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Each of them should separately recite one hundred and eight times, in the best manner.
